findings.title: Clarifications section still labelled as assumed, contradicting the refund rule
findings.why: The refund rule now comes from spec 001, but the header (line 3) still says open questions were settled by assumption, and the section title still says the rule is assumed and can be changed if the school's policy differs.

findings.title: Refund-rule bullet is redundant and refers to plural constants
findings.why: The bullet says twice that the rule comes from spec 001. It also mentions `REFUND_*` constants, but only `REFUND_FULL_BEFORE_MS` remains in src/index.ts.
